name: orange juice (discarded whole fruit)
origin_note: juice of discarded whole oranges, diluted to 19.5 g/L total sugar (dilution not stated)
wa_note: oranges widely grown and sold in Nigeria

name: grapefruit juice (discarded whole fruit)
origin_note: juice of discarded whole grapefruit, diluted to 19.5 g/L total sugar (dilution not stated)
wa_note: grapefruit less common than orange; supply not checked

name: citrus peel and pulp aqueous extract (orange, grapefruit, lemon)
origin_note: peel and pulp residue after juicing, boiled in water 3:1 for 1 h; topped up with commercial sugars in the study
wa_note: orange peel is plentiful where juice is sold; others not checked

name: commercial sugars (sucrose, glucose, fructose)
origin_note: used to top up peel extracts to the sugar target; refining aid not stated
wa_note: sucrose and glucose widely sold; fructose not checked

name: date fruit extract (Alig and Kentichi, low-grade dates)
origin_note: ultrasound-assisted water extract of low-grade dates (40 C, 20 min, 10 mL per g)
wa_note: date palm grown in the Sahel belt; supply to southern Nigeria not checked

name: fresh coconut water (mature coconuts)
origin_note: filtered water of mature coconuts, used at 50% (v/v) and topped up with sucrose to 8 degrees Brix
wa_note: widely sold in coastal West Africa

name: coconut water pre-fermented by yeast (YPCW)
origin_note: fresh coconut water fermented 3 d at 30 C by one of 11 yeast strains; peptone carry-over from the YEPD starter at most about 0.2 g/L in the medium
wa_note: needs a pure yeast starter (SC7 best); strain access unverified

name: coconut water pre-fermented naturally 3 d (NPCW)
origin_note: fresh coconut water left 3 d at room temperature, natural microflora, unfiltered and unsterilised when prepared
